Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh will have to bat really well if they are to chase down this target. Wickets will be crucial for them. The batsmen have done the job for the Kiwis, now the onus will be on the bowlers. They will look to strike early and put more pressure on the Bangladeshi batsmen. The chase starts in a while, join us for it.

The day started brightly for the Bangladeshi bowlers. They stuck early with the new balls but weren't able to stop the run flow. That led to them not being able to pick wickets. Mortaza started well, but did not get good support from the other end. Both, Rubel and Mustafizur went for aplenty, going for 157 runs in 19 overs combined, taking 3 wickets between them. There was some respite in the middle overs, with Saifuddin and Mehidy Hasan exerting a bit of control but not getting much wickets.

41 runs in the last 3 overs means that the Kiwis have rocketed the score again. They did not start in the best of fashion though, losing Colin Munro cheaply while for a change, Martin Guptill was not able to capitalize on it. Now, with the score reading 59/2 and without Kane Williamson, it looked like the Kiwi batting lineup would succumb under pressure. But Henry Nicholls and Ross Taylor joined hands and stitched a 92-run stand. Both went on to score half centuries which settled the innings a bit. That gave a good platform for the rest of the batting and the lower middle order made full use of it.
Fuller ball on middle, Santner gets low to swing. He drags it through square leg and they come back for the second. 11 from the final over and NEW ZEALAND END WITH 330/6 AFTER THEIR 50 OVERS.
Colin has dug out that yorker at the last second towards the off side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Lovely! Pitched up on middle, de Grandhomme just chips this over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On the stumps, Santner looks to go on side but gets an inside edge near the stumps. They cross.
Outside off, driven past covers for a brace. Good running.
Full on middle, hit to mid on and gets to the other end.
SIX! 18 runs from the over and Santner gets to the groove. Full toss on middle, Mitchell gets a good piece of it and deposits this over the long on fence. The Fizz ends with figures of 10-0-93-2.
Better. Gets this in the hole, de Grandhomme digs it out towards mid on for one.
FOUR! Another cutter is dispatched to the boundary. On the shorter side, Colin stands tall and slaps this over cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! Cutter again outside off. De Grandhomme swings and gets an outside edge past the keeper. Third man is too wide and cannot get near the ball.
SAFE! Cutter outside off, de Grandhomme slices it towards extra cover. The ball lands safely and they take two.
Fuller ball on the stumps, hit to mid on. They change ends.

SIX! No, he cannot. Slower delivery which is bowled a tad shorter in length, de Grandhomme picks it up early and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. It was a very good over before this ball but 11 runs come off it.
Full outside off, Mitchell hits it towards cover and takes a single. Just 5 runs off this over so far. Can he finish it with a dot or a single?
Full on middle and leg, de Grandhomme nudges it towards long on for a single.
Back of a length close to the body, Santner hits it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike. Brilliant first three balls from Saifuddin, just 3 singles.
Yorker length outside off, de Grandhomme guides it towards third man with a slant bat for a run.
Full on middle and leg, Santner hits it towards long on and takes a single.
Mohammad Saiuddin is back.
FOUR! Carved away! Pitched up ball on off, Colin gets under it and slices this over backward point for a boundary.
Santner plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Outside off, cut to point for one.

OUT! Full toss on middle, The Fizz misses his length yet again. Latham swings but doesn't get the desired result. The ball goes towards Sarkar who takes a good low catch. The umpires checks for the no ball but it is on thigh height.
Mitchell Santner walks out at number 8.
Full toss outside off, Latham drives it to mid off. Rahim has a shy at the non-striker's end and once again no one backing up. They get two for it.
Cutter over the stumps. Latham picks up the slower ball. He looks to paddle this over the keeper but fails.
Good bouncer to end the over! Bangs it outside off, Grandhomme sways away from it.
On middle and leg, worked away towards mid-wicket for one.
De Grandhomme guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
SIX! First ball and a maximum. What a way to get off the mark. Angled into the pads of Colin who just works it away with power over fine leg for a biggie.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. One run added to the total.
Outside off, Latham drives it uppishly in the gap through covers and picks up two for it.
Colin de Grandhomme is next to bat.

OUT! Bowled! Mustafizur has the last laugh. Full on off, Neesham looks to heave it over but gets an inside edge and the ball crashes on the timber. Neesham is disappointed and rightfully so. He walks back and Bangladesh looking to restrict the Kiwis under 300.
FOUR! Another full toss by Mustafizur and this time he is punished.  Neesham is able to connect and lofts it over mid-wicket. The ball bounces inside the ropes and goes away for a boundary.
No, he cannot. Length delivery outside off, the ball does not bounce as much as James looks to hit it across the line but misses.

NO BALL! Slower one gone wrong. Mustafizur attempts a slower one but ends up bowling a high full toss. Neesham pulls it to the cow corner region and gets a brafce. The umpire signals a no ball and Free-Hit to follow. Can Neesham make the most of it?
Full around off, Neesham hits it wide of the fielder at mid off. These two are quick between the wickets and come back for the second.
Mustafizur is a lucky man. Bowls a juicy full toss on middle, Latham cannot make full use of it and hits it to the fielder at deep square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, Neesham looks to flick it but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards mid-wicket and they take a single.
Back of a length, cut but finds the fielder at point. 21 runs from Rubel's over.
SIX! Oh boy! Another one. Once again on the pads. This time Latham whips it away over square leg for back-to-back maximums. Gets to his 14th fifty in this format.
SIX! Effortless! Overpitched on the pads, Latham just flicks it away over the fine leg boundary for a biggie.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Neesham gets away with one! Short ball over the stumps. Neesham goes for the pull but gets a top edge to it. The ball flies towards fine leg. Mustafizur Rahman runs to his right and just puts one hand to the ball. The ball bounces just before the ropes and goes into the boundary.
FOUR! This time from the bat of Neesham. Fuller ball around off, James lofts this over covers now for a boundary.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
FOUR! SHOT! Pitched up on off, Latham lofts this over covers and doesn't bother running. Great hit.
Misses his length again and dishes out a full toss. Latham slaps it past the bowler towards long on for a brace.
Cutter outside off, Latham connects with thin air.
Low full toss on middle, Neesham swings and gets it towards cow corner for one.
Wide. Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! Wide signalled by the umpire.
Yorker in line of the stumps. Latham digs it out well.
Fuller ball on the stumps, carved away past point for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman introduced back into the attack.
Just 2 runs from the over. A good one for the visitors. Back of a length ball into the body. Latham misses his flick and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Around the off pole, Neesham gets this past point for a single.
Full and outside off, cut to point.
BOUNCE! Cross-seam around off. The ball climps after pitching and almost gets Neesham's outside edge.
Cutter angled away from Neesham. James throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to connect.
Tom flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack.
Defended off the back foot by Neesham.
On the thigh pads, Tom flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
On the pads, Latham flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery around off, Tom hits it towards mid on and shouts a loud no to his partner.
On middle and leg, Neesham flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Latham guides it towards third man for a single.
SIX! Similar, very similar to the previous one. Too easy. Around off, Neesham slogs this flatter over cow corner for half a dozen. 14-run over.
Latham plays this towards mid-wicket to give Neesham the strike back.
Neesham has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
SIX! HUGE! Quicker one, no real spin. Neesham gets under it and slogs this over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Quicker on in line of the stumps, kept out by Neesham.
Flatter ball on middle, blocked by Neesham.
Mahmudullah to bowl.
Shorter in length, Neesham pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He will keep the strike for the start of the next over.
On middle and leg, Latham nudges it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On the pads, Neesham nudges it towards the on side and gets off the mark with a single.
Back of a length on middle and off, Latham defends it with soft hands and takes a single.
James Neesham is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Ross Taylor holes out. Rubel Hossain gets his man. Short delivery on off, Taylor looks to pull it over the square leg fence but he does not time it well and it comes off the upper half of the bat. It gets the height and goes towards the fielder at deep square leg. Mahmudullah there comes to his right and takes the catch with his fingers pointing skywards. A huge wicket for Bangladesh, Taylor was playing really well and this partnership was going on smoothly.
Full length delivery on off, Taylor defends it.
Length delivery outside off, Ross pushes it wide of point and takes a single.
Length delivery on off, Latham looks to play it on the off side with a slant bat but gets an inside edge. The ball stay closer to the stumps and they take a quick single.
Taylor walks down the track for this one. Saifuddin sees it and bowls it on a length, Taylor pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Tom nudges it down towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Latham defends it off his back foot.
Good length delivery around the pads, Latham flicks it wide of the fielder at fine leg. He runs the first one hard and is quick to come back for the second. Brings the 50-run stand between these two.
Mohammad Saifuddin back into the attack.
200 up for New Zealand. They are going well and will look to get past the 320 total. Taylor cuts this past point to get to the milestone.
Taylor has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around the stumps, Taylor defends it from the crease.
FOUR! Made most of it. Goes short, Taylor gets behind it and slap-bats it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit hard.
NO BALL! Overstepping! Tight call though. Short ball down the leg side. Ross goes for the hook but cannot get bat to it. Free Hit coming up!
Outside off, punched past covers for a run.
On the pads, Taylor works it to fine leg and gives his skipper the strike.
Rubel Hossain to bowl his 6th over.
On the pads, Tom flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, Taylor guides it towards third man for single.
On the thigh pads, Latham looks to flick but misses and the ball flicks off his pads. They steal a run and the umpire signals it as leg bye.
Wide! Misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Latham looks to flick it but misses. The umpire stretches his arms and signals it as wide.
On middle and leg, Latham flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full around off, Latham gets on his front foot and hits it straight through mid off for a boundary.

Inches away from a comical dismissal. Slower delivery outside off, Latham hits it towards the fielder at mid on. The bat slips off his hand and almost goes on to hit the stumps. Luckily for him the bat does not go onto hit the timber.
Three dots in a row to end the over. On the pads, Ross flicks it to the fielder on the on side.
Flighted on the stumps, Ross taps it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Latham pushes it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Quicker one on the pads, Taylor flicks it away to the fine leg region for a single.
Shorter in length on middle, the ball spins in towards the southpaw who hits it towards long on for a single.

DRINKS BREAK. New Zealand are taking the game away from Bangladesh here. Nicholls departed after scoring his 50 but Ross Taylor has continued from the other end and has put up a 30 run stand with the skipper, Tom Latham. They are going at a solid run rate and are on course to post over 300.
Good slower ball to end the over. Cutter outside off, Taylor swings but fails to connect.
Another overthrow. Poor from Bangladesh. Taylor flicks this fine towards square leg. The fielder there has an unnecessary shy at the non-striker's end which enables them to complete the second.
NZ pinch two just 15 meters away from the bat. Taylor taps this towards point and sprints to complete the run. The fielder cannot collect the ball cleanly and they steal an overthrow.
Fuller this time around off, Taylor stonewalls it.
FOUR! Cutter on a back of a length outside off. Taylor made the adjustment and guided it just past the diving keeper for a boundary to the third man region.
Slower ball on the stumps, blocked by Taylor.
History maker! On the pads, Taylor nudges it towards fine leg and takes a single. With that Ross Taylor becomes the highest run scorer for New Zealand in ODIs going past Stephen Fleming.
Flighted on the stumps, Ross defends it with a straight bat.
Sprays this down the leg side. Taylor leaves it alone and the umpire signals it as wide.
Off spinner on middle, Latham nudges it towards mid on for a run.
Shorter in length, Latham drives it through point and gets a brace.
Fifty for Taylor! Flighted on middle, Taylor pushes it towards long on and takes a single to bring up his 47th ODI fifty.
Tossed up around off, Latham hits it through covers. He runs the first one fast and looks for the second but Taylor was not interested.
On the pads, Latham flicks it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller length delivery on middle and off, Latham looks to flick it to the on side but gets a top edge and the ball goes to the fielder at cover.
On the pads, Latham tucks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, Taylor works it down to the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Ross blocks it.
On middle and leg, Tom flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside leg, Ross looks to flick but it flicks off his pad.
Outside off, Latham pushes it towards long off for a single.
Tom has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted around off, Latham follows the six with a front foot defense.
SIX! Great footwork by Latham. Flighted delivery on off and middle, Tom comes down the track and heaves it over long on for a maximum.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Taylor nudges it towards long on and takes a single.
Length delivery around off, Latham blocks it to see off the over.
Fuller outside off, Taylor plays it with soft hands towards short third man and takes a run.
Good length delivery on middle, Taylor looks to tuck it on the on side but gets a top edge and the ball goes back towards the bowler.
On middle an leg, Taylor flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full and straight around off, Ross blocks it with a solid front foot defense.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Latham tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Latham works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Outside off, cut to point.
Taylor works this past mid-wicket to get to the other end.
The next man in is Tom Latham.

OUT! The bowling change has done the trick. Hasan flights this way outside off, makes Nicholls reach for it. Henry goes for the sweep but drags his shot to deep mid-wicket. Tamim gets under it and makes no mistake. Mehidy does what he was asked to do and ends the 92-run stand. Nicholls walks back after a well played 64.
Full on middle, hit past mid on for one.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Mehidy Hasan is back into the attack.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Almost a catch. Nicholls chips it ball towards the bowler. Mortaza dives to his left but cannot get his hands to the ball. The ball rolls towards long on where Mahmudullah dives and keeps it to two.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around off, kept out by Taylor.
Taylor has played it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! The boundaries are coming at ease. Fuller ball on the off side. Taylor cuts it through point for a boundary. With that he now gets to 8000 ODI runs. Needs 7 more to get past Fleming at the top.
Henry has pushed it to the cover region.
FOUR! Third one of the over. Nicholls takes it on the full and sweeps it through square leg for another boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Two Wides! Pressure on the bowler. Bowls this wide down the leg side. The keeper cannot get behind it. The ball goes towards fine leg where they take two.
FOUR! New Zealand cutting loose. Full and on middle, Taylor drives it along the carpet past the bowler. The long on fielder cannot cut it off and it will give Ross back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Outside edge and away to the fence. A tad short close to the stumps. Taylor cuts but gets an outside edge which flies to the third man boundary.
On off, punched back to the bowler.
Mahmudullah is asked to bowl.
Play and a miss. Back of a length delivery outside off, Nicholls looks to slash it on the off side but misses it.
On the pads this time, Nichollls flicks it to the same fielder.
On a length on middle and leg stump, Nicholls tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.

Full length delivery outside off, Nicholls drives it through covers. Sabbir Rahman runs to his left at sweeper-cover and saves the ball from going to the fence with his boot. Nicholls comes back for the second.
Bouncer. Bowled outside off, it bounces too high and Nicholls leaves it. The umpire signals it as wide.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Nicholls pushe sit to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Full on the pads, Nicholls hits it over the fielder at mid-wicket inside the circle and the ball races away to the fence.
On middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
50 for Nicholls. His 8th in this format and he continues to make merry in every position he bats. Pushes this towards covers to get to the milestone.
On the leg side, worked away to deep square leg to rotate strike.
Punched off the back foot by Nicholls. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle and leg, driven to mid on and gets off strike.
Pushed to the cover region by Nicholls. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. Fuller ball on off, Taylor creams this through covers. The ball races away and they get 11 from the over.
Excellent running. No risks but still keeping the score board ticking. Turns this away through square leg for another brace.
Around off, blocked from within the crease by Taylor.
The 50-run stand is up between these two. Taylor tucks this away into the square leg gap and comes back for the second.
On the pads again, worked away to the on side for a run.
Nicholls has flicked the ball off his pads. Two runs added to the total.
Mustafizur Rahman back into the attack.
Another single to end the over. Pushed to the mid on region and Nicholls will retain strike for the next over.
Fuller on the stumps, flicked to the man stationed at mid-wicket.
Outside off again, hit past point but they don't run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On off, driven past mid off for a single.
Taylor has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Good running. Outside off again, Taylor taps it with soft hands near the pitch and quickly completes the run. The 100 is up for NZ with that single.
Outside off, cut past point for a single.
Extra bounce over the stumps, Nicholls punches it to mid on.
Taylor plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
On the stumps, blocked by Taylor.
Back of a length ball around off, taped to the off side.
Henry has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

That would have been some catch. Tossed up delivery on off and middle, Taylor looks to play the paddle, Liton Das behind the stump sees it and moves to his left and stretches his left hand out. He gets his glove to it but cannot hold onto it. Taylor gets a single.
Shorter in length, Nicholls pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Taylor pushes it wide of the fielder at mid on and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the stumps but his throw is slow.
Flighted on middle, Taylor defends it with a straight bat.
Shorter in length around off, Nicholls hits it towards cover and takes a single.
Follows that boundary with a solid front foot defense.
FOUR! Taylor once again walks down the track. Saifuddin sees it and bowls it a bit short. The ball comes on the waist region and Ross hits it through mid on for a boundary.

Good length delivery on off, Taylor comes out of his crease and pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his left and takes the pace off the ball. Taylor gets a couple as the ball goes in the deep.
Good length delivery outside off, Henry pushes it wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Nicholls pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Fuller in length on middle stump, Nicholls taps it back to the bowler.
Takes on the mid on fielder again and sprints to complete the run.
Fuller ball on middle, Nicholls on-drives it towards mid on. The fielder there misfields which enables them to come back for the second.
Taylor plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
On the leg stump, turned away to the man at mid-wicket.
Taylor looks to sweep this but the ball has taken the inside edge and thudded into his pads.
On middle and leg, Nicholls rocks back and punches it to long on for one. With that, Henry Nicholls gets to 1000 ODI runs.
Similar line and length, Taylor walks down a bit but blocks it well.
Good from Saifuddin. Not giving room for Ross. This one is on the fifth stump line, Taylor defends it.
Around off, driven to covers for nothing.
Driven through the covers by Henry. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full again on middle, pushed to mid on and denies the single.
On the fuller length on off, Nicholls blocks it from within his crease.
Full on the off stumps, Taylor is solid in his  defense.
On the pads again, Taylor flicks but cannot get it past square leg.
Flighted ball on off, blocked with a straight bat.
Loopy ball on the leg stump. Pushed to long on for one more.
Off spinner on the pads, worked away to the man at 45 for a run.
Outside off, punched away past covers for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is to bowl post the Drinks break.

DRINKS BREAK. Bangladesh have started this match on the front foot and have sent both the opener back to the pavilion. They will need to continue to build the pressure and continue striking regularly. New Zealand will hope Nicholls and Taylor can stitch a partnership here and guide them to a good total.
On the leg stump, tucked away uppishly towards short mid-wicket.
Good running, put the fielder under pressure and got there with ease. Around off on a fuller length. Taylor drives it past covers and comes back for the second.
Back of a length ball on the body, Taylor tucks it around the corner. Dot ball.
Wide outside off, Nicholls reaches for it and drives it through covers for one.
Played to the point region by Ross. They pick up a single.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, played with a straight bat by Taylor.
FOUR! Shorter in length on the leg side, Nicholls pulls it fine towards the fine leg region and the ball races away to the fence.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Good fielding. Length delivery on the thigh pad, Nicholls flicks it away through square leg, Sabbar runs from deep mid-wicket and shows some good footwork to save the ball from going to the fence with his feet. The batsmen come back for the second.
Full on middle and leg, Ross pushes it towards mid on and takes a very quick single.
On the pads, Nicholls flicks it to the on side for a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Taylor guides it towards third mand gets a single.
Length delivery pitching outside off and for the third time in this over Nicholls misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full on off, Nicholls taps it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Nicholls defends it.
Once again length delivery pitching outside leg. Henry  tries to flick it but misses and it hits him on his pad. There is a stifled appeal by the bowler but the umpire turns it down.

Pitching outside leg, Henry looks to flick but it goes off his thigh pad towards fine leg. There is no fielder there so the keeper goes after it and saves it from crossing the rope. Nicholls comes back for the second. The umpire signals it as leg bye.

Good length delivery outside off, Taylor defends it with soft hands and calls for a quick single. The fielder at cover gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. It looked like Taylor would have been in had he hit the stumps as well.
Around off on a fuller length, Ross drives it towards covers to get off the mark.
Beaten! Beauty from Hossain. Drags his length back a bit. On a good length, the ball seams away after pitching. Ross goes forward to push it but gets beaten for the swing.
Goes full again on that fourth stump line. Taylor on-drives it towards mid on.
Full again on off, Taylor taps it with soft hands but cannot get it past point.
Fuller ball around off, driven to covers.
On middle and leg, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Ross Taylor walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT. It is a clean catch and Guptill has to depart. Full length delivery on off and middle, Guptill looks to loft it over mid-wicket but doesn't get the distance on it as his bat turns in his hand. Tamim Iqbal at deep mid-wicket runs to his right, holds the ball and then realizes that he will cross the rope. He then tosses the ball up. The toss up is not the best one as it is a bit behind him but he jumps in time and catches it and comes back in the field. The replays show his feet were off the ground when he took it and he came back in without touching the rope. The centurion from the last two games cannot get the third one in a row and New Zealand lose their second wicket.
Now then! Tamim has taken a stunner but the umpire has taken it up to have a look. Look's out but Tamim too ask the umpire to refer it.
On middle and leg, Nicholls nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker length delivery outside off, Guptill manages to get his bat down and guide it towards third man for a single.
Fuller in length this time around off, the ball stops and comes to Guptill. He checks his shot and almost ends up giving it back to the bowler. Luckily for him it falls short of Saifuddin.
Length delivery outside off, Guptill pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery on middle, Martin defends it to start the over.
Mohammad Saifuddin to roll his arm over.
FOUR! Good length delivery outside off, Nicholls cuts it wide of the fielder at backward point. The fielder there dives to his right but cannot get close to it. The ball races away to the fence.
Good length delivery around off, Henry pushes it away towards the fielder at cover.
On the pads this time, Martin tucks it away towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Length delivery outside off, Martin hits it to the fielder at point.
On middle and leg, Guptill flicks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On a length around off, Guptill looks to hit it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Nicholls keeps it out to see off the over.
Good length delivery on off, Nicholls once again gets an inside edge onto his pads. He looks for a single but Guptill turns him down.
On the thighs of Nichools, he looks to flick but misses.
Good length delivery on off and middle, Henry looks to pull it but gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad.

In the air but safe. Full length delivery on off, the ball stops and comes to Guptill. He looks to hit it but gets a top edge. Mortaza who was furious with Soumya Sarkar for standing too far in is too far away this time and the ball falls short of him. Guptill rotates the strike.
Full length delivery outside off, Guptill stands still and hits it hard but straight to the fielder at mid off.
50 up for the Kiwis. Fuller ball on the pads, Nicholls flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. 9 runs from the over.
Short on off, pulled away by Guptill through square leg. That travelled quickly to the ropes which keep the batsmen to two.
Closer to the stumps, Guptill covers his stumps and blocks it out.
Length ball around off, punched away to the off side.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Over mid off and the skipper doesn't look happy at all. Fuller length ball on off, Guptill looks to loft it over mid off. He does so and the ball bounces just outside the inner circle and runs away to the fence. Mortaza was unhappy because Sarkar was way inside the ring. Had he been on the line, there was a chance of him catching that.
Defended off the front foot by the Henry presenting the full face of the bat
FOUR! Hossain pulls back the length on this occasion. Nicholls sees it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Henry shows the full face of  the bat and defends it off his back foot.
On middle and leg, Guptill tucks it away towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Length delivery on off, Guptill pushes it to the fielder at cover.

FOUR! Poor fielding from Mustafizur. Good length delivery around off, Guptill looks to cut but gets it off the toe end of his bat. The ball skies wide of the fielder at third man. Mustafizur there runs to his right and gets near the ball. He doesn't judge the bounce and the spin and so the ball goes under his arm and away to the fence. Rubel Hossain looks very disappointed by the fielding effort there.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. On the shorter side outside off, Nicholls sees the width on offer and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Good ball. Length delivery outside off, there is a slight away swing on this one. Nicholls looks to defend it but gets beaten. The ball misses the outside edge by just a whisker.
Back of a length on off, Nichollls defends it off his back foot this time.
Good length delivery on off and middle, Nicholls defends it away.
Half volley around off, Henry drives it brilliantly but straight to the fielder at cover.

Full and straight on the fifth stump line, Nicholls looks to hit it through cover but gets it off his lower half of the bat and the ball goes wide of the fielder at third man. He does well to stop the ball going to the fence. Nicholls comes back for the second.
Around off, Guptill tries to get on the front foot and punches it towards cover-point.
On a good length on leg, tucked away to the on side for nothing.
Full and wide outside off again. Pushed to the cover region for a quick single.
FOUR! Boundary for Nicholls to get off the mark. Short ball on the body. The ball skids a bit. Henry waits for it and controls his pull behind square for a boundary.
Full and wide outside off, angled away from the southpaw who leaves it alone.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it on a good length on middle and leg. Guptill taps it with soft hands towards mid on and gets off strike.
Rubel Hossain to bowl his first over.
Yes he can. Slightly fuller on the stumps, Nicholls takes no risk and defends it. Great over for Bangladesh, a wicket-maiden from the skipper.
Length delivery outside off, the southpaw lets it go to the keeper. Can Mortaza finish it off with a wicket maiden?
On the fourth stump line, Nicholls leaves it alone.
Back of a length around off, Henry gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length delivery on off, Nicholls starts his innings with a solid defense.
Henry Nicholls is in at no. 3.

OUT! LBW! The skipper has got the breakthrough here and Munro's bad form in ODIs continues. Full length delivery pitching on off, the ball comes in with the angle. Munro looks to play it across the line but misses it and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. It looked plumb and Munro does not even try asking Guptill about the review. He knows what he has done and walks back quietly. His return to the side is not a good one and he will be disappointed with his effort.
FOUR! Brilliant timing. Good length delivery around off, Guptill hits it between cover and point. The outfield here is quick and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length this time by Rahman, Martin keeps it out off his back foot.
Length delivery on the stumps, Guptill defends it with a straight bat.
Good length delivery around off, Martin hits it to the fielder at cover.

SIX! Brilliant shot from Guptill. Fuller in length, Martin heaves it straight behind the bowler's head. He gets great height on it and also gets good distance, 89m to be precise and the ball sails over Mustafizur's head for a maximum.
Good length delivery on the body, Munro tucks it away towards fine leg for a single.
Good fielding. Slightly fuller around off, Guptill drives it through cover but Saifuddin dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.
On middle and leg, Martin hits it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Bounce on this one. Pitched on length, the ball rises onto Munro. He looks to defend it he and does so but gets hit on the glove. The ball goes towards the on side and they take a single.
On the pads again, this time Guptill flicks it away towards short fine leg and takes a single.
Good length delivery on the pads, Martin looks to flick it but misses and gets hit high on his thigh pad.
On middle and leg, Munro flicks it away wide of mid-wicket and takes a single.
Slower delivery in the very first over by Rahman. Pitched on length, Guptill defends it.

Good length delivery on middle and leg, this one jags back in. Munro looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Mustafizur appeals but no one joins him and the umpire turns it down. Meanwhile, the batsman pick up a single.
Straight and full this time on off, Guptill drives it wide of the mid off fielder and takes a quick single.
Slightly fuller this time, Guptil hits it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery around off,  Martin pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Rahman starts with a length delivery on middle and leg, Colin tucks it away towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Slightly fuller this time on off and middle. Martin defends it off his front foot. 4 runs off the first over.
Good length delivery outside off, Guptill shoulders arms to it.

Beautiful shot! Full and straight on off, Munro just drives it past the mid off fielder. Mahmudullah gives it a chase against the quick outfield. He does well to dive and save the ball going to the fence. Munro comes back for the third.
First run of the day. Full length delivery on the pads, Guptill flicks it towards fine leg for a single. He gets off the mark.
On the fifth stump line this time. Mortaza gets a bit of bounce wit away movement on this one. Guptill does not bother playing at it.
First ball of the day and Mortaza bowls it outside off. There is a very slight inswing on it, Guptill leaves it alone.
We are all set to begin. Colin Munro and Martin Guptill walk out to the middle to open the innings for New Zealand. The skipper Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl the first over for Bangladesh.

PITCH REPORT - Craig Cummins is out there with the pitch report and he says it is sunny and humid here in Dunedin. Suggests there is a nice grass covering on the 22-yards. Feels that the bounce here will be medium at best and suggests it will be a nice batting wicket. Admits it is humid here and there is a bit of a color on the pitch, hence he feels there will be medium pace and bounce. Ends saying that there will be a bit of moisture on the surface.

Tom Latham, New Zealand's stand-in skipper feels that the pitch looks good. Suggests that they should put runs on the board and then be able to defend it. Mentions that he has three changes to his side. Kane Williamson, Todd Astle and Matt Henry are out while Colin Munro, Mitchell Santner and Tim Southee come in. On his captaincy, he says that they are a good bunch of guys to lead and he enjoys it. On this being their last ODI game before the World Cup he reckons that it is important to the perfect game of cricket.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says the wicket gets better as the game progress and hence he has opted to bowl first. Admits that both the departments (bowling and batting) have been weak and reckons they will have to improve. Admits that the performance in the middle-order needs to be better in this game. On Mohammad Mithun, the skipper says he misses out this game due to a hamstring injury.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and have elected to field first.

Hello and welcome to the third and final ODI between New Zealand and Bangladesh. This is the last ODI for the Kiwi's before the World Cup and they have rested skipper Kane Williamson for this one. It will be interesting to see whether they name a strong playing XI or will they test their bench strength. The visitors, meanwhile, will look to avoid a whitewash and go to the Test series on a back of a win. They will definitely be looking to improve their batting performance which was below average at best in the first two games. They will have to make-do without their best batsman of the series, Mohammad Mithun, who is out of this one due to injury. Lots to play for. Live action begins in a while, stay tuned for updates...
